analytic_theorem: For every loopless simple oriented input graph with global cyclomatic number at most two and undirected girth at least five, Hom(G,T5) is nonempty.
analytic_proof_scope: Core is cycles/bridges or a theta of three paths. For theta girth>=5, either lengths 1,4,4 => supports (2,5,5), lengths 2,3,3 => (3,4,4), or lengths>=3 => (4,4,4). Terminal support intersection is nonempty.

costs.fixed_template_transfer: 110 integer accumulator updates; 15 terminal multiplications; 5 sums; cyclic gauge factor five; all source parsing, path recognition and arithmetic charged separately
costs.feedback_edge_dp: 5^r endpoint pin configurations for r<=2k, times O(n+m) local 5-state tree evaluations, k<=2 for proved always-SAT class

limitations: This is a structural necessary condition for UNSAT within a bounded-cycle-rank class, not lower bound for unrestricted algorithms. All finite census claims are COMPUTATIONAL, P versus NP remains OPEN.
